 ## Overview
 
-`tidysynth` is a tidy implementation the [synthetic control method](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synthetic_control_method) in `R`. A synthetic control offers a way of evaluating the effect of an intervention in comparative case studies. The method aims to model a counterfactual unit using a weighted average of units that did not receive the intervention. The effect of the intervention can be estimated by comparing differences in the observed and synthetic time series. See Abadie et al. [2003](https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/000282803321455188), 2010, [2015](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/ajps.12116) for more on the method and use cases.
